ssnit.name: SSNIT
ssnit._note: Total mandatory pension is 18.5% (5.5 employee + 13 employer). SSNIT retains a Tier 1 portion and forwards a Tier 2 portion to a licensed occupational pension trustee — tier1SplitOfTotalPct/tier2SplitOfTotalPct below encode that split for reporting only (they don't change what's withheld from the employee). VERIFY the current split against SSNIT/NPRA guidance before relying on this for a real payroll run.

tier3.name: Tier 3 Provident Fund
tier3._note: Voluntary — rates are 0 by default and only apply per-employee when Employee.tier3Enrolled is set with a contribution rate. reliefCapPct is the combined employer+employee tax-relief ceiling (% of basic salary) under the National Pensions Act. VERIFY current NPRA guidance before relying on this for a real payroll run.
